met-681122.alt: Bird-and-flower decorated case shown with its mirror exposed and a fitted drawer partly extended.
met-681122.caption: Muhammad Baqir’s Iranian case is dated 1204 AH/1789 CE. These views show outer birds and flowers, a mirror and fitted dressing storage. The catalogue also describes an inner-lid courtly gathering, which these photographs do not show. No secure Shiraz workshop, purchaser or actual depicted event is established.
met-681122.printCaption: Dated 1789, after Karim Khan’s death. These views show birds, flowers, a mirror and fitted storage. The catalogue’s inner-lid gathering is absent here; a secure Shiraz workshop remains unknown.
additionalImageAlts: Birds among flowers and foliage on the bordered rectangular case lid.
Empty fitted drawer with shaped recesses for dressing implements and painted borders.
